query: select p.proname,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) as definition,encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex') as sha256,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) as owner,p.proconfig,p.proacl::text as acl from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace='rakeezx'::regnamespace and p.proname in ('apply_sync_v2_mutation','apply_sync_v2_mutation_before_student_0029') order by p.proname limit 3

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.apply_sync_v2_mutation(p_entity text, p_record_id text, p_mutation_id text, p_device_id text, p_base_revision bigint, p_patch jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_operation text DEFAULT 'patch'::text, p_client_updated_at bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin
      if auth.uid() is null then raise exception using errcode='42501',message='Authentication required'; end if;
      perform rakeezx.lock_student_lifecycle(auth.uid());
      return rakeezx.apply_sync_v2_mutation_before_student_0029(p_entity,p_record_id,p_mutation_id,p_device_id,p_base_revision,p_patch,p_operation,p_client_updated_at); end; $function$
